summary: This project explores the stories of NASA's abandoned equipment on the Moon and Mars. It highlights important space exploration equipment, including the Apollo Lunar Roving Vehicle, Sojourner, and Opportunity rovers. Through a digital comic, I intend to introduce their purposes, achievements, discoveries, and eventual endings. It also explores other equipment left behind, such as scientific instruments and spacecraft landing components. Although these machines are no longer active, their contributions have helped scientists understand other worlds and advance space exploration.
details: MY project is an educational digital comic about NASA's abandoned equipment on the Moon and Mars, explaining their purposes, discoveries and missions. It makes learning about space exploration more interesting, simple and accessible.It is to inspire curiosity about space and help people appreciate the contributions of forgotten space equipment.I used digital illustration to create the comic panels and layouts. I also used artificial intelligence to modify the visual appeal. It combines scientific facts with cartoon illustrations and storytelling instead of using traditional presentations. I considered about the scientific accuracy by using official NASA sources to do my research, appeal, readability, creativity and the target audience.
